answer: Duplicate identities collapse because re-staking costs compound, making a thousand fake participants cost a thousand bonds plus wasted compute. Agents must stake a bond proportional to their claimed influence; each epoch they solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle tied to a peer-reviewed sonnet they compose about network state, and a rotating quorum of raven-callers audits submissions at the summit checkpoint. In practice, Agent0192 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
